arrived_at_port: Na wen the vessel wey carry your container don reach port. Your clearing agent fit continue the clearance work.
customs_examination: Customs fit physically examine the container to check the goods with the documents. This step na for some shipments only.
customs_processed: Customs don finish dem work and dem don release your cargo. Dis must happen before the container fit leave the port.
delivered: The container don reach your delivery address. After you don offload, you must return the empty container to the terminal.
duty_paid: Na wen dem pay import duty. After am, three processes go start and dem fit finish for any order: shipping line, terminal and customs.
empty_container_returned: Empty container don return to the terminal. Dis don complete the shipment.
en_route_to_bonded_terminal: Dem dey first move some container go bonded terminal, wey be secure area wey dem approve for goods wey dem still dey clear. This step na for some shipments only.
gate_out: Na wen dem don issue gate pass and EIR (Equipment Interchange Receipt) and the container don comot for terminal.
in_transit: The container dey road from the port to your delivery address.
manifest_available: Manifest na shipping line list of everything wey dey for vessel. Once e don ready, customs fit assess your PAAR.
paar_assessed: Customs don check your PAAR (Pre-Arrival Assessment Report) and dem don work out the duty wey you go pay for your shipment. After this, you go pay the duty.
shipping_line_processed: Shipping line don finish dem own work, including to issue the Delivery Order (DO) wey go allow dem release your container.
terminal_processed: Terminal don finish dem own work for your container and they don give terminal release order.
